comment: Full Cindy progressions, scored in Cindy mode (see tests/README.md). Kept apart from youtube.json because the one clip here carries a known, pre-existing pull-up undercount that would otherwise turn the single-movement regression run red. Expectations are ground truth.

scenarios.notes: One full round of Cindy in a garage, about 79 s: 5 kipping pull-ups at the back (~8-23 s), a walk to the mat, 10 push-ups with a kneeling rest at ~36-41 s (~29-52 s), then 15 air squats (~57-78 s). Labels were counted by eye from contact sheets (a zoomed 3 fps sheet of the pull-up rig; 2 fps sheets of the mat) and cross-checked against an independent oracle, hysteresis on the raw elbow and knee angles, never the counter; the two agree on every rep. labelledBottomsMs gives the bottom of each push-up and squat and the chin-over-bar moment of each pull-up. Pull-up tops are the least certain (kipping, rear three-quarter view), to about +-0.5 s. Only one round exists locally, so the pull-up to push-up switch is crossed once; a longer excerpt is needed for more. Scored with setup skipped, because production counts 1 of the 5 pull-ups on this camera angle, too few to calibrate, and skipTo stands in for the athlete tapping skip when the app has not moved on by itself. That pull-up undercount is a pre-existing limitation unrelated to identity, hence known-gap.
